metadata.policy_summary: Queue-first local control plane. Session-only work should be recreated from this spec; continue_task heartbeat 設為 */30 * * * *（嚴格 30 分鐘等距，對齊 Claude Code Max $200/月 plan 1-hour prompt cache TTL，已於 2026-04-26 經 Anthropic support article 驗證）。The formal clock is the Operations Core shared scheduler, while idle_policy only governs slot-aware continuation/selection. 派工 cadence（2026-07-20, telegram-1198）：15 分鐘一班的成本評估曾依賴 hourly_pregate；demand-only gate 下是實打實 4x（池永遠有 P1/P2 → 7 天 164 fire would_skip=0）。加上 novelty gate 後，估算 15min 約為 hourly 的 1.84x（30min 1.35x、60min 0.87x；scripts/analyze_dispatch_cadence.py 可重跑）。【2026-07-30 H4-4 最終裁定】2026-07-20 後 production shadow 最終 crosscheck 共 229 班，產生 10 班 would_skip；其中 9 班仍有可歸因的實質產出（90% 誤判，門檻 ≤10%）。因此不是延長 shadow 或補更多 heuristic，而是正式 retire：runtime schedule 移除 pregate config，decision/scheduler 移除 collect/enforce 分支，舊 CLI 只回報 retired/no-decision 且不寫證據。歷史 log 與 scripts/crosscheck_pregate_outcomes.py 僅保留為 retirement 前後稽核基線；不得重新取得派工否決權。

ownership_contract.shadow: legacy owners execute; operations core records predictions only
ownership_contract.canary: only active_jobs execute in operations core; every other job remains legacy
ownership_contract.active: operations core owns every enabled system_crontab job
ownership_contract.cutover_rule: set active_jobs.<id>.activated_at before removing that exact legacy owner
ownership_contract.rollback_rule: remove active_jobs.<id>, reconcile legacy owner, then verify next legacy receipt

items.label: feed.json -> Supabase 全量對帳（收斂網）
items.description: WS-C2（refactor_plan_ops_master_2026_07 §3）：每小時 `volpred ops feed-sync --apply --no-delete --quiet-when-clean`，把 canonical feed.json 的變更收斂到 Supabase articles 投影。Safe upsert 由 `publisher.article.supabase.reconcile` family owner決定執行路徑：legacy generation走既有逐篇caller；operations_core generation把本次完整、唯一slug排序的article objects與canonical feed SHA綁成單一immutable batch，經private payload store、WorkItem、EffectRequest/outbox、primary-authority lease與typed read-back acknowledgement執行；owner transfer用generation CAS，operator rehearsal驗證exact rollback。此 job是C1即時寫入之外的收斂網；無drift時 `--quiet-when-clean`完全不輸出（只留cron_lib start/exit receipt），有drift才記錄。刻意不帶 `--allow-delete`：破壞性刪除仍屬單一守門者 `supabase_sync.reconcile_article_deletes`（floor/cap/dump不變式），不與safe family共用owner或無人值守權限。排在audit_publish_sync之前，讓同一個piggy-back tick先收斂再稽核。由run_due_jobs piggy-back執行；每小時check_alerts觸發，有效cadence為60分鐘。
items.exit_semantics: 0=clean or every attempted projection acknowledged,1=one or more projection effects unacknowledged

items.description: Hourly: local published vs complete same-window Supabase projection vs live URL parity audit. 每輪原子寫 storage/ops/publisher_projection_convergence_latest.json 並 exact read-back；同時以 versioned config/public_article_projection_contract.json 的 exact policy SHA 稽核 frontend INTERNAL_DETAIL policy。contract 缺檔、壞JSON、digest/frontend drift或注入evidence不符皆標 unavailable；remote credentials/transport 不可用同樣禁止把空集合誤報成 projection drift。exit 0=converged、1=proven drift findings、2=observation unavailable。

items.label: 任務池 in-flight 宣告 vs 磁碟/進程 liveness 對帳
items.description: WS-A4（refactor_plan_ops_master_2026_07 §3）：每小時 `scripts/liveness_reconcile.py --apply`，把 next_tasks 的 claimed/in_progress 宣告拿去對磁碟（worktree 是否還在）與進程（dispatch_state 的 pid，經 dispatch_supervisor.procutil 做 pid-reuse-safe 指紋比對）兩項現實。兩項都證明死了、且 claim 已過 20 分鐘寬限期，才經 canonical helper task_pool_claim.release_owner_claims() 降回 pending 並寫 receipt 到 storage/ops/liveness_receipts/。任一項存活即否決降回：多數 fire 本來就不建 worktree（單看磁碟會誤殺整個佇列），而 worktree 還在代表可能有未合併成果（feedback_no_research_artifact_loss）。與 handoff_regen 的 `cleanup --stale-hours 2` 互補不重疊：那條是純年齡掃描（無證據、2h 才動手），這條是證據制（有兩項死亡證明、20 分鐘就能收回鬼佔的 slot）。吸收 k1709 殭屍教訓（in_flight=7 而實際 running=0）。排在 ops_dashboard(:30) 之後、handoff_regen(:50) 之前，讓 dashboard 讀到的是對帳前現況、handoff 讀到的是對帳後佇列。由 run_due_jobs piggy-back 執行（有效 cadence 60 分鐘）。

items.label: stale worktree 產物裁決開單（WS-I 落地保證）
items.description: WS-I（工作產物落地保證）：每 6 小時 `scripts/reclaim_stale_worktrees.py --open-tasks` — dry-run 盤點 stale worktrees，對每個 held（dirty 或 unmerged）worktree 冪等開一張 P3 main_thread 裁決任務（id=worktree_salvage_<name>），出口三選一：merge_worktree.sh 整合 / path-scoped 救援 / 判定放棄後正規 remove（禁 --force）。動機：偵測一直都有（reclaim dry-run、daily_checkup worktree_reconcile、liveness worktree-veto）但沒有 actuator，2026-07-20 累積 16 個 stale worktrees、最久 138h，k1380 的有效 results 困在未提交 worktree 而 main 只有 INVALID 版。本 job 絕不帶 --apply：破壞性 kill/remove 仍是主線程手動決策。與 liveness_reconcile(:45) 分工：那條收回 claim（任務池側），這條收割產物（磁碟側）。由 run_due_jobs piggy-back 執行。
6h: FB stale pending audit

items.label: Operations Core → agent dispatch executor tick
items.description: Every minute Operations Core delivers one local Unix-socket tick to the KeepAlive dispatch executor. Operations Core is the only schedule owner; the executor has no independent scheduler and only owns admission, four worker slots, retry/failover, health monitoring and PHASE-Z. The tick is cheap and model-free when no hourly slot or explicit request is due. A missed tick is retried; after app/daemon/Mac restart the next tick re-evaluates canonical last_fire_at and fire_requested_at without duplicate execution.

items.label: Operations Core compute queue drain/restart insurance
items.description: Issue #46 canonical compute executor trigger. Operations Core is the only clock and dispatches a detached work-conserving compute queue drain every 15 minutes as restart insurance; the wrapper itself returns within the 60-second scheduler timeout. The queue-wide flock preserves one drain loop, while each queued job keeps its own timeout, provider guard, immutable receipt, schedule fire identity and output contract. The legacy com.volpred.compute-worker LaunchAgent is retired after a natural Operations Core receipt and queue execution read-back.

items.label: Receipt-backed natural-growth experiment lifecycle
items.description: Issue #27 canonical lifecycle owner. Every five minutes Operations Core reads the durable experiment registry and idempotently advances the committed article-share CTA experiment through activate, exposure stop, attribution maturation, and frozen closeout. Stable command receipts make retries and restart catch-up safe; the job never rewrites research facts, buys traffic, or requires Claude/Codex Desktop to stay open.

items.label: Hourly Work Coordinator shadow evidence observation
items.description: Issue #9 pre-cutover evidence producer. Every hour it freezes canonical next_tasks, its paired queue-owner state, local TaskRecord receipts and Supabase ops_jobs once, runs the shared legacy/Work Coordinator selectors, and appends one ignored owner-bound work-shadow-replay.v4 receipt. Only receipts whose owner mode, gate flag, state path and state SHA match assessment-time owner evidence count toward the seven-day window; historical v3 receipts remain audit-only. It never submits, claims, completes, stages a gate or changes queue ownership. Canonical owner is the hourly check_alerts run_due_jobs piggy-back.

items.label: Legacy retirement typed-signal materialization
items.description: Issue #46 production evidence producer owned exclusively by Operations Core. Every five minutes it verifies the immutable legacy-business-fire and dispatch orphan-work event chains, reads the private duplicate-effect ledger, reconciles the formal WorkItem lifecycle against DB-clock deadlines and exact terminal receipts, and refreshes all four fixed typed interval signals. Five minutes is strictly below the retirement recorder's ten-minute source-freshness ceiling. It does not append a retirement observation, start the fourteen-day clean window, execute legacy business work, or call an external provider.

items.label: Legacy execution retirement observation recorder
items.description: Issue #46 canonical retirement recorder owned exclusively by Operations Core. At minute 02 each hour, after the */5 signal materializer has refreshed all four typed sources at minute 00, it reruns the fail-closed formal owner census and appends one immutable, hash-chained observation bundle. Existing owner or violation blockers are recorded honestly and reset the clean suffix; only a zero-violation observation can begin or extend the fourteen-day window. Host cron and piggy-back execution are forbidden, catch-up is skipped to preserve truthful cadence, and no legacy business work or external provider is invoked.

retired_items.description: Slot-aware continuation heartbeat。cron `*/30` 嚴格每 30 分鐘等距 fire（每小時 :00 / :30），永遠落在 Claude Code Max $200 plan 1-hour prompt cache window 中央，cache 命中率最佳。2026-04-26 用戶指定 4h→30min；先嘗試 50min 但發現 `*/50` 標準 cron 解析為 :00 / :50（50/10 不等距），改用 `*/30` 才是真正等距。Cache TTL 已於 Anthropic support article 'Using Claude Code with your Pro or Max plan' 確認 Max plan = 1h；Pro / API key = 5min。**單一 cron 行表達等距 cadence 的限制**：只能用 60 的因數（1/2/3/4/5/6/10/12/15/20/30/60）；45 無法用單一 `*/45` 等距表達（會解析為 :00 / :45 = 45/15 gap）；要真等距 45min 需 3 條 entries cycle 過 3-hour period。歷史 2026-05-10 用戶問 45min，回答 vanilla cron 限制，最終保持 `*/30`（或可選 hourly `0 * * * *` 真減頻）。注意：2026-03 初 default TTL 曾悄悄從 1h 降到 5min（GH issue #46829），Max 訂閱保持 1h 但需監控未來變動，若降級則本 cadence 失效。Slot fill rule (per feedback_pool_fill_to_threshold): cron fire 時 slot < 4 派 (4-current) 個 agent 並行補滿，不一次一個。

idle_policy.source_label: Slot-aware idle continuation policy (updated 2026-04-17 for M1 Max 10-core, cap raised 3->4)
idle_policy.note: Use after a top-level agent completes its main task instead of a high-frequency heartbeat cron. This is a continuation/selection policy, not a standalone scheduler clock. Priority ordering decides WHICH task to pick; it does NOT mandate sequential execution.
idle_policy.max_concurrent_agents_owner_note: ⚠️ 此欄位無程式讀取（2026-07-19 全 repo grep 確認），是歷史敘述值。agent 並行度的唯一 enforcement owner = scripts/dispatch_slot_budget.py（base 4 / P1 surge 6 / auth_blocked de-rate 2 + worktree progress-based occupancy）。要改 agent 並行度請改該腳本；改這裡不會生效，也不要讓它變成第二個 owner。
rules: 硬體容量：M1 Max 10 核，同時最多 4 個 agent（每個約 1-2 核 + 1-2GB RAM + 1 個 worktree），保留 ≥1 核給主線程 buffer。
每次觸發先 count 當前 running agents（.claude/worktrees/ + background task ids）。若 >= max_concurrent_agents 則跳過。
slot 有空就挑新任務：(1) user-assigned pending 最高優先 (2) scheduled queue (3) discovery / research continuation。不必等 user queue 清空才 discovery。
同一個 K 編號 / 任務 id 不得同時被兩個 agent 執行（啟動前 ls experiments/ + ls .claude/worktrees/ 檢查）。
discovery pass 最多每 30 分鐘一次（整體節奏限制，不是 slot 限制）。
user queue 仍優先於 discovery — 若有 user pending，下次 slot 空出時必須優先挑 user。
每次 idle-driven continuation 或 discovery pass 之後，必須產生實際工作成果（新 agent running / git diff / knowledge 新增 / research_program 更新），不能只回報狀態。
next_tasks 主動補滿：每次 cron tick check；若 P4 pending < 2 或 P3 pending < 5，從 research_program.md / knowledge.json / 最近 NULL 實驗衍生新任務補齊；不等 queue 清空才 refill。

history.change: Deprecated */4 heartbeat; introduced queue-first sequential idle continuation.
Relaxed to slot-aware concurrent execution (up to 3 parallel agents on M1 Max 10-core); priority ordering still enforced but no longer sequential.
Raised max_concurrent_agents 3->4 (context still manageable, keeps ≥1 core headroom). Added proactive next_tasks refill: trigger when P4<2 or P3<5.

cron_jobs.description: Retired hourly dispatch policy row. Operations Core owns the clock and executor; only the canonical schedule policy remains here.
cron_jobs.reason: Deliverable 8 physically retired the legacy executable surfaces. Operations Core agent_dispatch_tick invokes the executor through a Unix socket; this row remains only as canonical hourly schedule policy. H4-4 retired the heuristic pregate after its final production crosscheck found 9 substantive-work false skips among 10 skip candidates.
cron_jobs.note_schedule_still_canonical: Operations Core ticks the executor every minute; dispatch_supervisor/scheduler.py load_cron_expr() reads this row's `schedule` to decide whether that tick represents the hourly business slot. The executable, live copy, LaunchAgent, and pregate authority no longer exist.

cron_jobs.description: Compute queue worker — work-conserving drain loop (D6 2026-07-20): `run-loop` consumes ALL queued heavy-CPU jobs (MLE/bootstrap/data fetch/agent) continuously with bounded parallelism, exiting only when the queue is empty; runs without Claude tokens. Parallel bound: `max_parallel` on this entry if set, else min(3, cpu//3) — keeps M1 Max headroom for dispatch agents + interactive session. The */15 tick is RESTART INSURANCE only: a tick landing while a drain loop is alive loses the flock worker mutex and exits immediately; ticks also revive jobs sleeping on not_before (quota windows). Token-conserving split: feeds interpretation agents via hourly_dispatch PHASE A.

producer_custody.rationale: 2026-07-29 production safety cutover：supervisor 以 launchd resource coalition + per-fire process unique-id baseline 追蹤 setsid／leader-exit 後仍存活的 producer。shared coalition 無法安全區分同時起跑的多個 fire，因此 scheduler 必須機械限流為單一 slot；恢復多 slot 前須先切到 per-fire isolated coalition 並完成 live drain read-back。

codex_failover.rationale: 2026-08-01 activation gate：Codex subscription failover 與 Claude fire 共用 exact job custody；synthetic OAuth lease 在 materialize 時即有 durable recovery identity，所有 terminal path 必須先證明完整 producer cohort（含 setsid descendants）drained，再 reconcile／刪除 credential。shared launchd coalition 仍維持 max_slots=1，未知 custody、lease recovery 或 provider policy一律 fail closed，不回 legacy runner。

daemons.max_slots_rationale: 2026-07-29 shared_launchd_coalition custody safety mode：單一 shared coalition 的 per-fire baseline 在並行 fire 下會互相看見新成員，故 production 必須 max_slots=1；scheduler.load_max_slots 即使讀到漂移值或無效值也 fail-safe clamp 1。2026-07-19 的 4-slot throughput 設定暫停，待 per-fire isolated coalition 通過 regression + live drain proof 後才可恢復。
daemons.fires: Receives model-free ticks only from Operations Core job agent_dispatch_tick; each tick evaluates the hourly volpred-hourly-dispatch policy plus state.fire_requested_at

writer_isolation.rationale: Issue #43 enforce cutover：每班 mutating-capable fire 由 supervisor 在 agent spawn 前機械配發 registered worktree，worker cwd 與 macOS sandbox 綁定該 workspace；active cap、disk floor、binding、receipt 或 lock 失敗只會釋放 slot 並保留 fire request 重派，禁止 shared-main fallback。candidate head + main base 進 durable gate receipt；main 前進必 rebase + re-gate，integrator 以雙 SHA fence 落地。canonical storage 只容許既有帶鎖 CLI；workspace 內 storage/** 變更在 merge gate fail closed。max_active=1 與 shared_launchd_coalition 的單 slot custody gate 一致；max_total=3 是 artifact backlog advisory threshold，超限必寫 durable allocation_advisory，但保留的事故證據與待整合產物不占 execution capacity、不得阻斷新 fire。

daemons.description: Long-lived dispatch executor after the Operations Core cutover. It has no schedule clock: a local Unix-socket trigger server accepts Operations Core ticks, while the process retains the independent health monitor, single-slot shared-coalition worker, retry ladder and cohort-drained PHASE-Z safety commit. Claude quota/auth failure hands the same exact job, isolated workspace, producer custody and subscription-only credential lease to Codex; no legacy runner is re-enabled. Schedule-trigger receipts and model-delivery outcomes remain separate. Failure alerting owner = its own alerts.py (completion_failure/quota/hang/auth) — host_cron_fail deliberately does NOT cover model outcomes.
